## Summary

Wrote `/out/manifest.json` partitioning spf13/cobra (`adbc881...`) into 6 units:

- **command-model** (domain) — `command.go`, `command_win.go`, `command_notwin.go`: the `Command` type, execution/dispatch engine, help/usage rendering
- **positional-args** (domain) — `args.go`: positional-arg validators (`ExactArgs`, `MinimumNArgs`, etc.)
- **template-runtime** (infra) — `cobra.go`: template-function registry, init/finalize hooks, `CheckErr`, string utilities
- **flag-groups** (domain) — `flag_groups.go`: required-together/mutually-exclusive flag constraints
- **shell-completions** (domain) — `completions.go`, `shell_completions.go`, `active_help.go`, and the bash/bash-v2/zsh/fish/powershell generators, kept as one unit since they share unexported constants across file boundaries
- **doc-generators** (infra) — the `doc/` package: Markdown/man/reST/YAML doc generation from a command tree

All 36 `.go` files are accounted for (19 across the 6 units, 17 test files excluded); non-Go files (docs, CI, build config, `.claude/`) are excluded too. Recorded one real cross-unit violation: `command.go:1188` reaches directly into a `shell-completions`-owned annotation constant instead of a public accessor. I verified the partition against this repo's own lint hooks (`.claude/hooks/lint_stub.py`), which checks full file coverage, entrypoint-location consistency, dependency-edge validity, and declared-vs-detected effects — it reports 0 blocking errors.
